en: In the real app: a short, kid-safe video ad. Here it is just a wait ({n}).
You can close it after {n} seconds

A bright arcade hall with a domed orange roof, full of blinking games. The star machine is Squish Breaker, where your own squishies are the bouncing balls. It grows from a little game stall into a neon arcade with a squishy bouncing on the roof.
A little striped stall with one blinking game.
Glowing neon bricks, flags, star medal and sparkles.
A board showing the best scores.
A small hall with a round orange roof.
A pile of numbered bricks by the door and awnings.
Big windows full of blinking screens.
A giant squishy bounces on the roof.
A purple game cabinet out front.
The town’s music stage. It starts as two crates and a microphone, grows into a gazebo bandstand with curtains and spotlights, and ends as a big concert shell.
A big arched shell behind the stage and sparkles.
A purple striped awning on posts.
A round bandstand roof on white posts.
Lilac paint and railings; the octopus joins the band.
Red curtains, spotlights and a taller roof.
A giant bouncing music note and fairy lights.
A tower of bamboo steamer baskets with a lid for a roof. It is the first house every player fixes up, so it teaches how renovating works.
Lid knocked sideways, windows boarded up, weeds, cobwebs and an old tyre.
Golden knob, star medal and sparkles. Complete!
Weeds pulled, a blue tarp over the hole in the lid, planks piled up.
The steamer lid sits straight again and gets its red knob back.
The walls are re-woven and turn golden again.
Boards come off, curtains go up.
A shiny new door, welcome mat and step.
Picket fence, flower boxes and a stepping-stone path.
Giant chopsticks frame the door, red lanterns on both sides.
Fairy lights on the lid, glowing windows, steam puffing from the vent.

The factory is where coins become squishies. Buy a Mystery Box, watch it ride the conveyor belt and pop open to reveal a random squishy. Rarer squishies are much harder to get. Next door is the Gem Shop, where the Legendaries and two shop-only squishies are sold directly (no luck involved) for Squish Gems.
A tiny shed with one box on the step.
Rainbow heart puffs, flags and medal.
Chimney puffs and a stack of boxes.
A sawtooth roof and a big loading door. Family Boxes unlock.
Boxes roll out on a conveyor belt.
A giant squeezy squishy sign on the roof.
A striped smokestack that puffs pink hearts.
Spinning gears in a side annex.
A golden box on the roof and fairy lights.

A fire station for the bravest squishies. There are no scary fires on Squishy Island: the firefighters spend their days getting the coloured water ready for the big Splash Parade, sorting every colour into its own bucket. It grows from a little hose cart into a big station with a fire truck and a hose tower.
A red cart with a flame sign.
A garage door and red trim.
A cute red truck with a ladder parks outside.
A tall red tower to dry the hoses.
A giant red toadstool on the edge of the woods. At level 1 the cap is droopy, mossy and full of holes. At level 10 it glows with fireflies and fairy lights.
A droopy, mossy cap with holes and boarded windows.
A tarp over the hole, planks and cone.
The cap is rebuilt round and sturdy.
Bright red cap with white spots.
A rustic fence, flowers and stepping stones.
Tiny colourful mushrooms and two lanterns.
Fireflies blink around the cap, fairy lights underneath.
A giant pineapple house with a spiky leaf crown. At level 1 the leaves are brown and droopy; by level 10 it’s the juiciest house on the hill.
Brown droopy leaves, faded skin, boarded windows.
Weeds cleared, planks and cone ready.
Fresh green leaves sprout from the top.
Bright yellow skin with its pineapple pattern.
A green arched door and mat.
Fence, flowers and a stone path.
A crate of fruit and a watering can by the door.
Two lemon-shaped lanterns on a string.

A sparkly little mine dug into the rocks at the edge of town, glowing with crystals and with a cart full of Gems on its rails. It is the only place in the game where real money is spent: grown-ups buy Squish Gems here, and the Gems are then spent on squishies in the Factory’s Gem Shop.
A greenhouse that starts as a single flower pot on a table and grows into a glass crystal palace with a windmill.
One flower pot on a wooden table.
A golden dome tip and sparkles.
A seed tray and a watering can.
A little glass box of seedlings.
A small greenhouse with a pointed roof.
A little windmill turns beside it.
A giant butter-yellow teapot with polka dots, a spout that puffs steam and a handle that works as a garden arch. Home of the famous breakfast squishies.
Lid tipped over, spout snapped off, boarded windows.
Golden knob, star medal and sparkles. Complete!
Tarp over the lid, cone and planks in the yard.
The lid sits back on with a new orange knob.
Fresh yellow paint, polka dots and a brand-new spout.
Arched door, welcome mat and step.
Picket fence, flower boxes and a stone path.
Striped awning over the door and a giant whisk & spoon fence post.
The spout puffs steam, fairy lights wrap the teapot.

The second way to get squishies. You are paired with a random player, you each put squishies on the table, and you haggle with three big buttons until you both accept. Only spares from your Spare Shelf can be traded, so the squishy living in your house never leaves.
Two squishies trading on a blanket.
Golden dome tip, flags and medal.
A crate counter under an umbrella.
A third tent and bunting. Wishlist board unlocks.
A wooden frame goes up over the stalls.
A teal roof and SWAP MEET sign. Friends stall unlocks.
A clock tower rises behind the roof.
Lanterns, flowers and fence. Event stalls unlock.
A glass dome tops the clock tower.
A giant pink conch shell on the sand. When you find it, it’s bleached grey and covered in barnacles and tangled seaweed.
Bleached grey shell, barnacles and tangled seaweed.
Seaweed cut away, planks and cone on the sand.
The shell gets its pink stripes back.
Round porthole windows with sea-blue curtains.
A new door inside the shell’s opening.
Sand path, driftwood fence and flowers.
A red-and-white beach umbrella and starfish on the sand.
A giant dog kennel with a bone-shaped sign, a chimney and an attic window. The busiest, waggiest house in town.
Hole in the roof, bone sign hanging crooked, boarded windows.
Star medal on the sign and sparkles. Complete!
Tarp on the roof hole, cone and planks out front.
Red roof tiles and the bone sign back in place.
Walls painted a warm biscuit colour.
Windows with yellow curtains, attic window cleaned.
A big arched door (big enough for the Corgi).
Paw-print stepping stones and two lanterns by the roof.
String lights along both roof slopes.
A playground that grows one piece of equipment at a time: a sandbox first, then a seesaw, slide, swings, a climbing dome, a castle tower, a trampoline, a zip line and finally a rainbow gate.
A sandbox with a bucket and spade.
A giant rainbow gate and sparkles.
A mint seesaw rocks up and down.
A ladder and a pink slide.
Two swings, one already in use.
A yellow duck on a spring.
The slide becomes a castle tower with a flag.
Plus a garden, fence and lamps.
A zip line from the tower top to a far pole.

A friendly police station that looks after Squishy Island’s Lost & Found. Squishies lose balloons, mittens and keys all the time, and the officers sort the jumbled lost-property box into neat matching rows. It grows from a kiosk into a station with a patrol car and a flashing siren.
A blue-and-white booth with a badge sign.
A notice board for missing-cookie posters.
A one-room station with a mansard roof.
Big windows and a sturdier front.
A cute patrol car parked outside.
Bulbs around the sign, flowers and fence.
A red and blue light flashes on the roof.
A cheerful yellow post office where all the letters in town get sorted. Har Gow (the letter-writing dumpling) is its biggest customer.
A teal-striped kiosk with an envelope sign.
A yellow building with a gable roof.
A post box out front and awnings.
A bike with a parcel crate and Har Gow.
A paper-plane weather vane on the roof.
A little restaurant where your squishies cook and serve hungry customers. It starts as a food cart and grows into a two-storey bistro with a terrace and a giant chef hat on the roof.
A striped-awning cart with a chef-hat sign.
A chalkboard menu and a potted plant.
A small one-room restaurant with a red roof.
Big windows to watch the diners.
Outdoor tables with umbrellas and customers.
Light bulbs around the BISTRO sign, garden out front.
A giant chef hat sits on top and steam rises.
A pink hair salon with a barber pole, where squishies come to get fluffy hairdos, colours and bows. It grows from a beauty cart to a domed salon with a hair-dryer on the roof.
A pink striped cart with a scissors sign.
A small pink salon with a domed roof.
A spinning red-and-blue pole and awnings.
Big windows to show off styles.
A sign by the door and a freshly styled guest outside.
A giant pink hair dryer blows bubbles.
A made-up family’s home: a fluffy cloud on a stilt. At level 1 it’s a grey, deflated rain cloud dripping on the grass. From level 6 the whole house gently floats.
A grey, droopy rain cloud with boarded windows.
A tarp patch, ladder and planks.
The cloud is still grey but the leaks are fixed.
The cloud fluffs up big and white.
Glass windows and a rope ladder to the door.
Three balloons tied on. The house starts to float.
Fence, flowers and a stone path.
A rainbow arcs down from the cloud with cloud puffs at its feet.
A cupcake house with a striped wrapper, a frosting roof and a cherry on top. When it’s broken, the frosting has melted into a sad grey puddle.
The frosting has slumped and gone grey, windows boarded.
Sticky mess scraped off, planks and cone out front.
A big fluffy swirl of pink frosting is piped back on.
Wrapper painted blue, sprinkles all over the roof.
The cherry chimney is back and the windows get glass.
A pink arched door and mat.
White fence, flower boxes and a stone path.
Two giant lollipops guard the yard.
Fairy lights loop around the frosting edge.

A shiny white lab where scientists test how squishy every squishy is. There is no score and no coins here: it is a place to squish, stretch, drop and press your squishies just because it feels good. It grows from a single test bench into a lab with a giant press on the roof.
A little bench with a measuring board. Tools: Hand and Drop.
A wall chart of squish scores. Tool: Ball.
A small white lab with a blue roof and a mini press out front. Tool: Press.
Blue awnings over the windows. Tool: Roller.
Big windows and a satellite dish on the roof. Tool: Squeeze.
An upstairs test room. Lets you test two squishies at once.
A bubbling glass tank with a jelly floating inside.
Bulbs, flowers and a fence. New table: trampoline.
A giant press squishes a giant marshmallow on the roof.
Nothing here yet. When a box gives you a squishy you already have, it waits here for you.
Stars buy missing Commons and Uncommons, and special decor, in the Star Shop.
Trading at the Market comes soon.
A bamboo basket bed with the lid as a blanket. Bao naps here.
Glows at night. The house windows glow warmer on the map.
Tea set for four. Unlocks a tea-party idle for two squishies.
Holds the Dumpling Gang’s letters from Har Gow.
Shaped like a sushi soy-sauce fish. Gyoza’s favourite seat.
A red wall charm. Small, cheap, the first item the tutorial asks you to buy.
A table and two stools. Unlocks a tea-time idle.
A real stump with a crackling fire.
Two stacked crates labelled FRESH. Two sleepers.
Blends a new juice each day; unlocks a slurping idle.
Hangs from the ceiling and glows warm.
Climbing vines grow a little each day you log in.
A crackly warm oven. Squishies warm their toes in winter events.
Two slots, two sleepers. Toast and Sunny Egg nap here.
Opens to show tiny outfits (cosmetic hats for the family).
Two warm bulbs inside a giant whisk.
A dinner plate rug. Butter’s favourite melting spot.
Glows with cookie shapes. Unlocks a midnight snack idle.
Opens and closes slowly as the squishy breathes.
Fish swim past and bubbles float up.
A pink coral branch that glows.
Stores your trophies. Sparkles when you get a new one.
Holds a starfish and a shell.
Three platforms and a dangling toy. Kitty sleeps on top.
Soft ring bed. The Corgi Loaf never leaves it.
Two goldfish swim in a loop. Cats stare at it in an idle.
Unlocks a yarn-chasing idle for Kitty.
Displays toys and trophies from minigames.
Hamster scurries through it in a loop.
Squishes down when a squishy lies on it.
Glows brighter at night in real time.
A pink kite with a bow tail.
Unlocks a star-gazing idle at night.
Seats three squishies. Frosting cushions squish when they sit.
A pair of swirly floor lamps.
Jars fill up as you collect more Sugar Squad members.
Shows the real time; chimes on the hour in-game.
Animated pouring chocolate. Unlocks a dipping idle.
That box can't be opened right now.
Every box has a squishy inside. One you already have goes onto your Spare Shelf.
The next box is Rare or better!
You have this one already, so it goes onto your Spare Shelf ({n} there now).
The rest is saved for a longer game.
Coins: beat a level for 30 + 15 per star (every 10th level pays double), replays 10 + 15 per new star
This squishy is extra good at this game!
First clear: 30 + 15 per star · big level ×2
No coins this time. Beat the level to earn coins!
This game is taking a nap, try another!
Build it on the map first.
Cozy {cozy}: this family earns +{pct}% coins in minigames
Find me in a Mystery Box!
Needs {n} family squishies living here (you have {have})
This game is taking a nap, try another!
Something went wrong opening your town. Nothing is lost: please update the game or ask a grown-up to contact us.
This town was saved by a newer version of Squishy Island. Please update the game to keep playing.
A round acorn wearing a cosy textured cap. Collects shiny pebbles and hides them "somewhere safe".
Peeks out of the left stem window.
A chill avocado who treats his pit like a round tummy. Takes life one sunbathe at a time.
Relaxes on a sunbed with sunglasses on.
A pink axolotl with frilly gills and a permanent smile. Can regrow a squish if you squeeze too hard.
Paddles in a little tide pool by the shell.
The famous squishy banana. Bendy, bouncy, and always in a-peel-ingly good spirits.
Pushes the lawnmower back and forth across the front lawn.
A fluffy steamed bun who squishes flat when you hug it and slowly puffs back up. Always warm, always smiling.
Cannonballs into the soup-bowl pool, hops out, and does it again.
A snow-white bunny with pink ears. Keeps the lawn perfectly trimmed (and nibbles a little of it too).
Pushes the lawnmower across the grass.
The viral butter block! Melts hearts (and sometimes himself). Lives for a warm slice of toast.
Lounges on a toast sunbed on the porch, slowly melting with happiness.
A corgi shaped exactly like a loaf of bread. Has never once been seen standing up.
Snores on the doormat right in front of the door.
A flaky French croissant with perfect manners. Says "bonjour" to every squishy who walks by.
Waves from the round window on the right.
A pink-frosted donut covered in sprinkles. Doubles as a pool ring on hot days.
Floats around a milk paddling pool like a pool ring.
A magenta dragon fruit with flame-shaped leaves. Pretends to be fierce, is actually a big softie.
Sits in the leafy crown, swaying in the breeze.
A sunny-side-up egg who loves sunbathing. Gets a little runny when nervous.
Floats in a frying-pan paddling pool, soaking up the sun.
A made-up fluffball critter with two bobbly antennae. Nobody knows where Fluffles come from, and they won’t say.
Peeks out of the round window in the cap.
A shimmering golden apple from the very top of the oldest tree. Said to grant one tiny wish a day.
Hovers on the front step, glittering.
A shining gold-ingot dumpling. Legend says it only appears to squishy keepers with kind hearts.
Floats above the lid knob, sparkling like a tiny sun.
A see-through gummy bear that glows every colour of the rainbow. Leaves a sweet sparkle wherever it goes.
Bounces on the front step, glittering.
A crescent dumpling with a crispy golden bottom. Loves lazy afternoons and the smell of sesame oil.
Naps on a striped sunbed in the side yard, softly breathing in and out.
A round little hamster whose cheeks are always stuffed with sunflower seeds "for later".
Pops in and out of the round attic window, cheeks full.
A see-through shrimp dumpling that blushes pink. Writes letters to every dumpling in town.
Stands on the front step reading the day’s mail.
A strawberry scoop on a crunchy waffle cone. Melts a little drip of joy when she laughs.
Waves from the round window in the frosting roof.
A wobbly lilac jellyfish who floats instead of walks. Glows softly at night like a nightlight.
Floats lazily in the air beside the shell tip.
An orange tabby who naps in every sunbeam. Purrs so hard she vibrates when you squeeze her.
Sleeps stretched out on the warm roof.
A golden-belled beckoning cat who waves good luck to the whole town. Never stops waving. Ever.
Sits on the very top of the roof, waving to everyone.
A minty macaron with a creamy middle. Very polite, a tiny bit fancy.
Peeks out of the left window.
The squishiest of all squishies. Gets toasty-brown on top when embarrassed.
Bounces on a jelly trampoline in the side yard.
A sleepy crescent moon made of soft mochi. Wears a nightcap all day "just in case".
Dozes on a sunbed with a nightcap on.
A fuzzy green ball of moss. Rolls everywhere instead of walking and is always a little bit damp.
Rolls back and forth across the side lawn.
A baby dragon with leafy spikes who breathes warm puffs of flower petals instead of fire.
Curls up on the edge of the cap, puffing petals.
A coral-red octopus who can wave eight hellos at once. Excellent at hugs. Very excellent.
Waves from the right porthole with two arms at once.
A royal stack of fluffy pancakes wearing a butter crown, with maple syrup dripping down like a cape.
Perches on the tip of the spout, glittering in the steam.
A fuzzy, blushing peach. The softest squish in the orchard, and the first to give a hug.
Peeks out of the left window.
A sweet longevity bun shaped like a peach. Rumour says hugging her makes your birthday come faster.
Sits on the steamer lid, swaying to music only she can hear.
A see-through mochi that splits sunlight into little rainbows on the floor. Very calm, very shiny.
A tiny runaway cloud who drifts wherever the wind goes. Makes the best pillow in town.
Drifts in the sky above the house.
A spiky-but-soft pufferfish. Puffs up round when surprised, which is about every five minutes.
Peeks out of the left porthole.
A golden puppy with floppy ears. Fetches the mail every morning and wags so hard his whole body wiggles.
Waits by the mailbox with a letter in his mouth.
A cloud with a rainbow for a tail. Only appears after the happiest rainstorms of the year.
Glides back and forth over the rooftop, leaving sparkles.
A bouncy raindrop who loves jumping in puddles. Every splash makes a tiny rainbow.
Jumps in and out of a puddle in the yard.
A slice of strawberry shortcake with fluffy cream layers. Always the life of every party.
Dances on top of the frosting swirl next to the cherry.
A little purple mushroom who dances whenever it rains. Leaves a ring of tiny flowers where it stood.
Dances on top of the big red cap.
A tiny seed who just sprouted two leaves. Waters itself every morning and grows a millimetre a day.
Waters itself with a little watering can in the yard.
A fallen star who never wanted to go back up. Glows brighter the happier everyone around her is.
Peeks out of the left cloud window.
A night-time bun with a golden star on top. Glows softly at bedtime so nobody is scared of the dark.
A sweet little strawberry with a leafy hat. Loves swinging so high she can see the whole town.
Swings on a tire swing under the yard tree.
A cheerful little sun with spinning rays. Wakes everyone up a bit too early, but nobody minds.
Sits on top of the cloud, rays slowly spinning.
A golden slice of toast with a crunchy crust and a soft heart. Early riser, first to say good morning.
Peeks out of the round window on the left.
An ancient sea turtle carrying a glowing pearl on her shell. She has seen every sunset since the ocean began.
Rests at the shell door, her pearl glowing.
A juicy watermelon slice with a big grin full of seeds. Splashes everyone at summer parties.
Pops into the right window, grinning.
A big blue whale who is the gentlest squishy on Squishy Island. Sneezes tiny rainbows from her spout.
Sunbathes on a beach towel, spouting a little fountain.
A soup dumpling with a twisty top-knot. Very curious. Secretly full of warm soup, so please squeeze gently.
Pops up in the upstairs window to watch the street.
This needs the internet. The map and all the games still work, though!
